gen-gf-turret-road-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Commanding and a little stern, Turret Road draws its rounded shapes with a pen-like line that never changes weight. And Sawarabi Gothic, a sans-serif with open jaws on every curve, keeps a long stretch of text easy on the eye.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-shippori-antique: Chunky, confident, almost stamped: Turret Road holds its pen-like line at constant weight while Shippori Antique rests below it with open, ladle-like bowls. Big and brief is where the heading belongs.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-shippori-antique-b: Turret Road's rounded shapes curve like open parentheses, all drawn in one pen-like line. Shippori Antique B1 follows with daylight through every curve, so a long passage would move along without any crowding.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-sour-gummy: Turret Road has a drafting-pen outline look, every stroke cut with one constant nib width. But Sour Gummy, a sans-serif with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, is what gives the pair its unusual range.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-spinnaker: Bold and a bit stern, Turret Road makes its arches as heavy as the stems beside them. Spinnaker, a sans-serif whose apertures keep every counter connected to the space outside, would carry a long passage with an easy, modern flow.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-stick: Commanding from the first letter, Turret Road rounds its shapes like open parentheses and holds a pen-like line steady throughout. It shouts well; Stick, with tubelike lines and exits wide enough for light, murmurs well.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-suse: SUSE reads friendly and approachable, a sans-serif whose curves have the heft of a rope and whose bowls tip open like a ladle. But Turret Road above it is all bold command, so the two feel like a shout and a smile.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-tajawal: Turret Road is all bold command, with no contrast between its stems and joins and a pen-like line of constant weight. And Tajawal, a sans-serif with a c shaped like a broad open hook, gives that force somewhere gentler to land.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-telex: Telex brings curvy letters that feel unclamped, easy and loose. And over a long stretch of text it keeps that looseness going, while Turret Road above it stays flat and stencil-cut from strokes of single weight.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-titillium-web: Titillium Web sets its stroke ends far apart, giving the body a contemporary, approachable look. And Titillium Web would keep a long passage moving along gently, a good foil for Turret Road's skimming ease and unchanging stroke weight.
